name: Destiny Tempest

notes.languages: cant speak any language, Telepathy 100, Truespeech

items.name: Center of Destiny
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet benefits from a fortune effect

---
Effect Shadows surround and steal away the destiny tempest, who reappears in an open space adjacent to the triggering creature.

items.name: Ebbing Cloud
items.text: 15 feet. Destiny tempests surround themselves with thoughts of averted fates, creating a thick metaphysical soup that cloys the mind and clouds ambition. Creatures in the area moving toward the destiny tempest treat the area as difficult terrain.

items.name: No Breath
items.text: Destiny tempests do not need to breathe.

items.name: Unspeakable Insights
items.text:
Touching a destiny tempest's mind even briefly grants a powerful and painful awareness of uncharted pasts, presents, and futures, too impossibly vast for mortal minds to conceptualize or contain. Whenever a creature targets the destiny tempest with a magical mental effect, it must attempt a DC 33 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to unspeakable insights for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 3d6 mental damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes 6d6 mental damage and becomes Confused for 1 round.

items.name: Divergent Potential
items.text: The destiny tempest chooses two creatures it can see within 60 feet and rolls two slithering whisper Strikes, one against each creature. After seeing the outcomes of the two Strikes, the destiny tempest chooses one of the two targets to pursue, Flies up to 60 feet to reach the chosen target, and uses the result of the chosen Strike; the other Strike is lost. If the destiny tempest is prevented from reaching its chosen target, the attack is prevented and the chosen Strike is lost.

items.name: Sound Without Voice
items.text: A creature damaged by the destiny tempest's slithering whisper Strike must succeed at a DC 33 basic Will save save or become Frightened 2.

items.name: Swiftness
items.text: A destiny tempest's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

text: Before the Jaathoom Empire, the Plane of Air was ruled by destiny tempests from their Reverient Empire of Lost Nights. When the jaathoom armies crushed the Reverient Empire, they trapped the defeated destiny tempests in bronze spheres scattered across the Plane of Air, prisons of time and everlasting nightmare.
